stories.title: Assemblea Onu, Araghchi incontra Witkoff: "Usa revochino blocco navale e scongelino beni iraniani"

en.title: UN Assembly, Araghchi meets Witkoff: "USA should lift naval blockade and unfreeze Iranian assets"
en.summary: At the 81st UN session with 200 world leaders, the US President signed a security agreement with Greenland and Denmark. Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi called for lifting the naval blockade and unfreezing assets, while leaders including Meloni and Erdogan addressed Arctic strategy and the Gaza conflict.

stories.title: Araghchi a Witkoff, 'Usa revochino blocco navale Usa e scongelino beni Iran'

en.title: Araghchi to Witkoff: "USA should lift naval blockade and unfreeze Iran assets"
en.summary: Iran set conditions for reopening the Strait of Hormuz, including the lifting of a naval blockade and unfreezing of assets, according to statements made during diplomatic discussions.

stories.title: Guterres: “In Cisgiordania spettro di pulizia etnica”. L’Iran detta condizioni per riaprire Hormuz

en.title: Guterres: "Ethnic cleansing threat in West Bank". Iran sets conditions for reopening Hormuz
en.summary: UN Secretary-General Guterres warned of ethnic cleansing risks in the West Bank while Iran laid out conditions for reopening the Strait of Hormuz. Trump stated the US would destroy Iran if an agreement is not reached, and Saudi Arabia reopened a bombed oil pipeline.

stories.title: ll conte Spencer risponde alle critiche: "Vi racconto mia sorella Lady Diana"

en.title: Earl Spencer responds to criticism: "I'll tell you about my sister Lady Diana"
en.summary: The Earl Spencer addressed accusations following the publication of his recently released memoir, which sparked a dispute with Buckingham Palace regarding accounts related to Princess Diana.

stories.title: Meloni a 'Cinque Minuti' e 'Porta a Porta': "Scuola, Mattarella vuole superare i ghetti"

en.title: Meloni on 'Cinque Minuti' and 'Porta a Porta': "School, Mattarella wants to overcome ghettos"
en.summary: Prime Minister Meloni discussed key national issues in interviews, including a 30% cap on foreign students, deficit concerns, tensions with Vannacci, wages, and criticism of opposition parties.

stories.title: Scuola, Meloni attacca Mattarella: “Da ministro voleva il tetto per gli stranieri in classe”

en.title: School, Meloni attacks Mattarella: "As minister he wanted a cap on foreign students in class"
en.summary: The Prime Minister referenced the President regarding past circulars on student caps, an issue from 1990, while opposition leaders criticized her statement as lacking respect for state institutions.

stories.title: Morto bambino in bici investito da un'auto a Torino

en.title: Child on bicycle killed by car in Turin
en.summary: A seven-year-old boy was struck by a vehicle and suffered severe injuries requiring emergency surgery. An investigation into the accident is ongoing.

stories.title: Meloni sfida Mattarella: “Da ministro faceva circolari sul tetto agli stranieri in classe, giusto procedere”

en.title: Meloni challenges Mattarella: "As minister he issued circulars on the cap for foreign students in class, right to proceed"
en.summary: The Prime Minister commented on past administrative actions regarding foreign student limits during a television program, while opposition figures accused her of provoking the President.

stories.title: Synchronized swimmer Sarah Rizea from Savona is Miss Italia 2026

en.title: Synchronized swimmer Sarah Rizea from Savona is Miss Italia 2026
en.summary: Sarah Rizea, a synchronized swimmer of Romanian heritage from Savona, was crowned Miss Italia 2026 at Santa Severa Castle.

stories.title: Sarah Rizea, miss di seconda generazione nell’Italia dei vannacci: “L’integrazione è una ricchezza”

en.title: Sarah Rizea, second-generation miss in Vannacci's Italy: "Integration is a wealth"
en.summary: An 18-year-old athlete of Romanian origin who won a beauty pageant has spoken about integration as a positive value, amid ongoing debate about restricting foreign students in schools.

stories.title: Muore a 7 anni investito a Torino, stava andando a scuola in bici con il papà. La protesta di quartiere: “Basta morire in strada”

en.title: 7-year-old dies in Turin after being hit while cycling to school with father. Neighborhood protests: "Stop dying in the street"
en.summary: A child was struck by a vehicle while riding a bicycle to school and died at hospital. The incident has prompted a neighborhood protest calling for improved road safety.

stories.title: Miss Italia 2026 è Sarah Rizea, 18 anni, nata a Moncalieri e atleta delle Fiamme Oro/ Video

en.title: Miss Italia 2026 is Sarah Rizea, 18 years old, born in Moncalieri and athlete of the Fiamme Oro
en.summary: An 18-year-old from Moncalieri who earned 100 medals in artistic swimming won the Miss Italia 2026 title.

stories.title: Procedure di estinzione, in rialzo le richieste di chi non ha nulla

en.title: Extinction procedures, requests rising from those with nothing
en.summary: Applications for debt relief from individuals with no assets have surged by 630 percent over a five-year period.

stories.title: Siderurgia: Federacciai, con caro energia a rischio continuità produttiva

en.title: Steel industry: Federacciai, energy costs risk production continuity
en.summary: Rising electricity and gas prices threaten the operational continuity of Italian energy-intensive industries, particularly steel manufacturers.

stories.title: Media, un articolo su cinque propone un’immagine negativa del Mezzogiorno

en.title: Media, one article in five presents a negative image of Southern Italy
en.summary: Research findings show that approximately one-fifth of media articles adopt a negative tone when reporting on Southern Italy, reflecting patterns in journalistic coverage of the region.

stories.title: Eventi dal vivo, la milanese Superstudio conquista Manhattan

en.title: Live events, Milan-based Superstudio conquers Manhattan
en.summary: Superstudio acquired a majority stake in Spring Studios New York and launched global expansion plans targeting 240 million dollars in revenue over five years.

stories.title: Europa attraente per investire, l’Italia batte Spagna e Svizzera

en.title: Europe attractive for investment, Italy beats Spain and Switzerland
en.summary: Europe ranks as the top destination for non-European business investment and corporate ventures, with Italy performing better than Spain and Switzerland among European countries.
